text:
The median asking rent in Gelsenkirchen stands at 7.56 €/m², with a year‑on‑year rise of 3.4 % and a five‑year gain of 23.5 %. The 25th‑percentile is 6.77 €/m² and the 75th‑percentile 8.45 €/m², placing the city 36th of the 37 most expensive German markets.

Market tightness is moderate: properties stay on the market for 41 days and only 16 % are let within a week. Vacancy is 3.4 % and the rent‑burden for a two‑person household is 13.5 % of income, while asking rents sit 38 % above the 2022 existing rent of 5.47 €/m².

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 8.02 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 7.78 €/m² and 8.17 €/m², a 6.1 % increase.
